contentBlocks.text: SASSA Options for Unemployed South Africans
Unemployment affects millions of South Africans. SASSA provides several social grants designed to assist individuals and families with no regular income.

checklist: Must be a South African citizen or permanent resident
Must have bank statements showing no recurring deposits
Must have a valid South African ID number
restrictions: You cannot receive this grant if you are receiving UIF, NSFAS, or any other social grant

steps.title: Submit your application
steps.description: Submit an application for the SRD R370 grant.

steps.title: Wait for verification
steps.description: Wait for bank verification and monthly review cycles.

faqs.question: Can I get a grant if I do casual work?
faqs.answer: Only if your casual work earnings fall below the monthly means test threshold (under R624/month for SRD).

faqs.question: Can I receive SRD R370 if I am actively looking for work?
faqs.answer: Yes, being unemployed and actively seeking work does not disqualify you. The SRD R370 is designed for unemployed individuals.
